functions.name: Start the native workbench
functions.behaviour: Build and open the retained MPUlt window with the full 600-cell viewport, tools, status bar and English controls. Source launch can select the runtime and data location and set the engine readiness deadline; input waits for bridge validation.
functions.notes: The retained host and bootstrap declare Version 0.3 even though this packet inventories the code retained for 0.4. Normal launch does not run native regression fixtures.

functions.name: Connect or reconnect the native bridge
functions.behaviour: Verify live geometry against the full model, obtain native slot and cell mappings, synchronize the committed state and restore the saved camera. The viewport and guarded tools are enabled only after the bridge and renderer succeed.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: File > Reconnect native bridge
functions.notes: The menu retries only while disconnected and idle; startup invokes the same connection path.

functions.name: Close the native workbench
functions.behaviour: Close the main window and dispose its heartbeat, auxiliary views and rendering adapters. If an operation is running, a confirmation allows closing to recover the last committed state on restart or cancelling the close.

functions.name: Show or hide the tools panel
functions.behaviour: Toggle the tools panel while retaining the requested visibility across automatic width changes.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Tools panel  F8

functions.name: Resize the tools panel
functions.behaviour: Drag the tools divider to set the preferred panel width; resizing the workspace fits or hides the panel to leave room for the viewport.
functions.notes: The preferred width is held in the live layout object; no persistence call is made here.

functions.name: Read controls and validation help
functions.behaviour: Show the native gesture and shortcut guide, log and reset guidance, full-model bridge requirements and the integration's validation limitation.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: Help > Controls and validation

functions.name: Open display and projection controls
functions.behaviour: Open a modal dialog with adaptive motion, cell and sticker size, field of view and lighting controls. Done, Enter or Escape dismisses it.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Display and projection…
button Display and projection · MPUlt: Done
key Display and projection · MPUlt: Enter
key Display and projection · MPUlt: Escape

functions.name: Toggle adaptive camera motion
functions.behaviour: Choose whether large visible views draw a sampled set during camera interaction and return to full detail after motion settles; picking restores a complete visible projection first.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Smooth camera motion (full detail when still)
button Display and projection · MPUlt: Adaptive motion; full detail when still
functions.notes: The menu and dialog checkbox modify the live renderer only. Wheel and native navigation keys are listed as the host's motion-notification triggers; their underlying MPUlt camera mappings are outside this source.

functions.name: Adjust cell size
functions.behaviour: Adjust tetrahedral cell separation by changing the native face shrink setting.
entry_points: window Display and projection · MPUlt / Cell size slider

functions.name: Adjust sticker size
functions.behaviour: Adjust sticker separation within each cell and synchronize dimensions used for newly visible meshes.
entry_points: window Display and projection · MPUlt / Sticker size slider

functions.name: Adjust field of view
functions.behaviour: Adjust the perspective angle and show its value in degrees.
entry_points: window Display and projection · MPUlt / Field of view slider

functions.name: Adjust diffuse light
functions.behaviour: Adjust directional surface shading through the original lighting control.
entry_points: window Display and projection · MPUlt / Diffuse light slider

functions.name: Adjust specular light
functions.behaviour: Adjust surface highlights through the original lighting control.
entry_points: window Display and projection · MPUlt / Specular light slider

functions.name: Adjust ambient light
functions.behaviour: Adjust uniform lighting through the original lighting control.
entry_points: window Display and projection · MPUlt / Ambient light slider

functions.name: Reset the main view
functions.behaviour: Restore the camera captured after the initial bridge connection, including radius, angle and cell/sticker sizes, and reload focused-cell grips.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Reset view

functions.name: Select the focused canonical cell
functions.behaviour: Select a cell using the zero-based toolbar field or a cell in either auxiliary canvas, synchronize the auxiliary selection and structure origin, and queue the canonical focus for the engine. Focus is shown with a cyan cell outline; selection alone leaves the main camera in place.
entry_points: window Main toolbar / Lab cell selector (0..599)
key Global overview canvas: Left click cell
key Focused neighborhood canvas: Left click cell
functions.notes: Auxiliary selection remains available during a main operation; the latest focus is sent when the host becomes idle. tests/native/NativeCellViewRegression.cs exercises click selection independently of centering.

functions.name: Center the focused lab cell
functions.behaviour: Recenter the main camera on the focused lab cell; the toolbar also reloads that cell's grip buttons.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Center focused cell
functions.notes: The center key action is configurable and has no default key in InitializeKeys.

functions.name: Select the active orbit
functions.behaviour: Select O00 through O34 in the toolbar or double-click a progress row to change the active orbit preference and refresh the native tools and display.
entry_points: key Main workbench / Progress: Double-click orbit row

functions.name: View per-orbit progress
functions.behaviour: Show solved counts, position errors and orientation errors for every reported orbit.

functions.name: Edit and apply visibility rules
functions.behaviour: Edit a whole-piece expression or JSON rule list and apply it as the visibility filter, clearing optional safety pinning. The filter summary marks unfinished edits until they are applied.
functions.notes: The configurable filter action opens this tab and focuses the editor; it does not apply the draft.

functions.name: Preview filter editor counts
functions.behaviour: Count matching whole pieces and sticker slots for the current draft without applying the rules; show parsing or service failures in the status message.

functions.name: Use a quick filter preset
functions.behaviour: Active orbit, Unsolved orbit, Orientation only, Work cell and All pieces apply immediately. Selected color, Selected current cell, Adjacent colors, Selected center layer and Selected home layer prepare an expression from the structure selection and preview its counts.
functions.notes: The two paths are explicit branches of LoadPreset; color and layer presets require a later Apply filter action.

functions.name: Show or hide the 600-cell frame
functions.behaviour: Toggle the persistent native frame visibility setting from the menu or filter checkbox while retaining the focused-cell outline.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Hide 600-cell frame

functions.name: Pin context outside the filter
functions.behaviour: Toggle whether buffer, selection and preview context is shown outside the applied piece filter.
entry_points: button Filters: Show buffers/selection/preview outside filter

functions.name: Expand the moving-orbit controls
functions.behaviour: Show or collapse the orbit checklist, its help and the Apply checked and Protect orbit buttons.

functions.name: Filter to checked orbits
functions.behaviour: Choose orbit checklist entries and apply their union as the visibility expression; an empty checklist applies nothing.

functions.name: Exclude an orbit from the filter
functions.behaviour: Right-click an orbit row to intersect every current editor rule with the complement of that orbit, preserving each rule's style, and apply the result.
entry_points: key Filters / Moving orbits checklist: Right-click orbit row

functions.name: Toggle protection of the active orbit
functions.behaviour: Add or remove the toolbar's active orbit in the protected-orbit preference list.
entry_points: button Filters / Moving orbits: Protect orbit

functions.name: Read filter syntax and motion guidance
functions.behaviour: Show or collapse examples of cell, color, adjacency and layer expressions and the explanation of display motion sampling and exact picking.
entry_points: button Filters: + Filter syntax and motion detail
button Filters: − Filter syntax and motion detail

functions.name: Expand frozen piece-set controls
functions.behaviour: Show or collapse the name, expression and identity/position kind inputs and the Save set button.

functions.name: Save a frozen piece set
functions.behaviour: Save the matches of an entered expression under a name, as either moving identities or fixed positions.
entry_points: button Filters / Frozen piece sets: Save set
window Filters / Frozen piece sets / Kind selector (identity, position)

functions.name: Preview an assisted insertion
functions.behaviour: Request a certified insertion preview for the active orbit, with automatic destination selection or an entered fixed position and a batch of 1..50. Show the preview note, primitive and star counts, complete support and certificate identifier.
functions.notes: When a fixed destination matches a required-piece inspection, the host uses the inspected destination orbit or reports why analysis is unavailable.

functions.name: Apply the pending preview
functions.behaviour: Submit the current pending preview token for durable commit and refresh the full native display from the resulting committed state.
functions.notes: The host only applies when idle, connected and a pending preview exists. Editors, structure controls and auxiliary canvases have separate Enter handling.

functions.name: Cancel a preview or stop a running job
functions.behaviour: When idle, cancel the pending preview; while busy, asynchronously request stopping the active engine job.

functions.name: Preview a focused-cell grip
functions.behaviour: Preview one of the seven backend-provided grip words for the focused cell. A right-click or the shifted number binding previews its inverse.
functions.notes: Button captions come from each returned axis label; indices 0..6 and both direction action IDs are defined here.

functions.name: Preview a primitive word
functions.behaviour: Parse an entered word using H/T cell notation or numeric generator IDs with optional prime inversion, then request a certified word preview. Invalid input opens an Invalid word dialog.

functions.name: Save the preview as a named macro
functions.behaviour: Save the current certified preview under the entered macro name and refresh the saved-macro library.

functions.name: Analyze a buffer destination
functions.behaviour: Analyze the automatic or fixed destination from Solve for its required identity, current occupant, buffers, reachable frames, setup depth and collateral/protection information.

functions.name: Inspect an analyzed buffer frame
functions.behaviour: Choose a returned frame to see its node number, setup depth, primitive length and setup word; the display warns when the puzzle state has changed since analysis.

functions.name: Preview a manually selected star
functions.behaviour: Request a certified star or inverse-star preview for the selected analyzed frame and orbit. The host rejects an absent frame or analysis from an older puzzle state.

functions.name: Save a named recovery checkpoint
functions.behaviour: Save the live native camera to preferences and create a timestamped Native checkpoint that appears in the checkpoint selector.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: File > Save checkpoint

functions.name: Back up the journal
functions.behaviour: Request a journal backup and refresh the native workbench after it finishes.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: File > Backup journal

functions.name: Restore a checkpoint
functions.behaviour: Choose a checkpoint, confirm restoration and load its state, visibility rules and saved native camera while leaving other journal branches available.
functions.notes: tests/native/NativeSessionLogRegression.cs exercises checkpoint restoration, label recovery and camera restoration; the Windows fixture was read, not run.

functions.name: Reset to solved with recovery
functions.behaviour: Send the live camera with the reset request, synchronize the solved result and show the automatically retained recovery checkpoint's name.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: Puzzle > Reset to solved (keep checkpoint)
functions.notes: tests/native/NativeSessionLogRegression.cs exercises reset and recovery of labels and the current camera; no native test was run in this task.

functions.name: Read recent journal branches
functions.behaviour: Refresh the history list with journal entry IDs, parent IDs and operation notes.

functions.name: Check out a journal entry
functions.behaviour: Make the selected history entry the current head and refresh the native puzzle state.

functions.name: Start the session timer
functions.behaviour: Start the thinking-time timer and fetch updated session totals for display.

functions.name: Pause the session timer
functions.behaviour: Pause the timer and fetch updated session totals for display.

functions.name: Read the session report
functions.behaviour: Show the current head and progress summary; explicit refresh adds scramble and solution primitive totals, stars, transaction and assistance counts and timer seconds/running status.

functions.name: Save a session log
functions.behaviour: Ask the engine to write a new log and report the returned saved-file path.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: File > Save log  Ctrl+S

functions.name: Import a verified puzzle log
functions.behaviour: Choose a 2-byte to 16-MiB file, detect C600 JSON/gzip or MPUlt format and send its bytes plus the live camera for import. Show the returned recovery checkpoint after successful verification.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: File > Import log…  Ctrl+O
functions.notes: tests/native/NativeSessionLogRegression.cs exercises C600 and MPUlt labelled round trips through ImportLogFromFile; the test source does not establish an executed result here.

functions.name: Export a puzzle log
functions.behaviour: Choose C600 verified session or MPUlt v1 format and a destination file; fetch the engine's log bytes and write them with an atomic replacement.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: File > Export log…
functions.notes: The configurable exportLog action has no default key.

functions.name: Export the proof session
functions.behaviour: Choose an output file, fetch the proof-session export and atomically save it, initially suggesting session.c600.json.gz.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: File > Export proof session…
functions.notes: The single Export puzzle record dialog definition is also used by certificate export (S4-54). Its window entry is assigned here once; each export menu has its own function row.

functions.name: Export a macro certificate
functions.behaviour: Choose an output file, fetch the certificate and atomically save it, initially suggesting macro.c600.json.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: File > Export certificate…

functions.name: Compose a commutator
functions.behaviour: Compose Word A and Word B as a commutator and show the resulting certified preview.
functions.notes: Words accept H/T cell notation and signed primitive IDs; an unchanged Preview to A caption retains the original certified recipe.

functions.name: Compose a conjugate
functions.behaviour: Compose Word A and Word B as A B A^-1 and show the resulting certified preview.
functions.notes: Words accept H/T cell notation and signed primitive IDs; an unchanged Preview to A caption retains the original certified recipe.

functions.name: Invert Word A
functions.behaviour: Invert Word A, including a certified recipe copied into A, and show the resulting preview.
functions.notes: Words accept H/T cell notation and signed primitive IDs; an unchanged Preview to A caption retains the original certified recipe.

functions.name: Concatenate macro words
functions.behaviour: Concatenate Word A with Word B and show the resulting certified preview.
functions.notes: Words accept H/T cell notation and signed primitive IDs; an unchanged Preview to A caption retains the original certified recipe.

functions.name: Copy the certified preview into Word A
functions.behaviour: Retain the full pending recipe as Word A and display a certified-preview caption, allowing further composition without flattening its recipe.

functions.name: Preview a saved macro
functions.behaviour: Choose a named certified macro in the library and request a preview of its saved recipe.

functions.name: Preview the inverse of a saved macro
functions.behaviour: Request an inverse composition of the selected saved macro's recipe and show the resulting preview.

functions.name: Inspect a clicked identity's home centers
functions.behaviour: Shift-left-click a visible interactive sticker to inspect its occupying identity and highlight its solved home Cell Centers in cyan. Show the source position, sticker color and the identity's current/home cells and correctness in Pieces.
functions.notes: This consumes a click of at most the normal 3-pixel movement threshold; Shift-left drag follows the inherited camera path.

functions.name: Inspect the identity required at a clicked destination
functions.behaviour: Shift-right-click a visible interactive sticker to locate and highlight the required identity in yellow and retain the clicked destination for insertion. Show buffer analysis in Buffers when available, otherwise show the reported reason in Pieces.

functions.name: Clear native inspection
functions.behaviour: Clear the inspection annotations and replace the Pieces text with the inspection instructions.

functions.name: Inspect and select a piece position
functions.behaviour: Select an entered physical position and show its occupying identity, orbit, home/current cells and solved, position-correct and orientation status.
entry_points: window Pieces / Inspect position P selector

functions.name: Track an inspected identity
functions.behaviour: Select the current position of the inspected identity and refresh its piece details.

functions.name: Browse unsolved pieces in the active orbit
functions.behaviour: Find the previous or next unsolved position in the active orbit, select it and show its piece details.

functions.name: Use a piece position as the insertion destination
functions.behaviour: Copy the Pieces position field to the Solve destination and turn off automatic destination selection.

functions.name: Find the identity required at a position
functions.behaviour: Retain the entered position as the insertion destination, locate the identity required there, select its current position and show its details.

functions.name: Center on an inspected piece's current or home cell
functions.behaviour: Set the focused lab cell to the first current cell or first home cell of the inspected piece, recenter the main camera and reload grips.
functions.notes: Both buttons use the same handler with a current/home parameter.

functions.name: Select native grips and journal manual twists
functions.behaviour: Pass accepted visible interactive clicks to the original native grip and multi-click selection logic, then send completed native turn tokens with the prior state hash to the labelled backend. Refresh the authoritative native state after the operation.
entry_points: key Main viewport: Chorded left/right click and subsequent selected-sticker clicks
functions.notes: The host gates releases for all three buttons and preserves native grip selection while restricting hits to interactive geometry. tests/native/NativePickingRegression.cs exercises a chorded selection followed by a committed multi-click twist; it is test source, not an executed Windows result.

functions.name: Recenter on a visible native cell
functions.behaviour: Ctrl-click a visible interactive sticker to let the original native callback recenter on its hit cell rather than a hidden framework face.
functions.notes: tests/native/NativePickingRegression.cs checks the Ctrl-left HWND path against the visible hit cell and confirms that hidden Ctrl-clicks are rejected; no Windows test was run here.

functions.name: Rotate the main view in 3D
functions.behaviour: Rotate the main puzzle camera in 3D through the retained MPUlt drag handler.
entry_points: key Main viewport: Left mouse drag
functions.notes: The gesture-to-camera mapping is declared in the host's help, and its input gate forwards drags to MPUlt. The actual camera implementation is in the supplied assembly, so the motion semantics are inferred from these two source facts.

functions.name: Rotate the main view in 4D
functions.behaviour: Rotate the main puzzle camera in 4D through the retained MPUlt drag handler.
entry_points: key Main viewport: Shift+Left mouse drag
functions.notes: The gesture-to-camera mapping is declared in the host's help, and its input gate forwards drags to MPUlt. The actual camera implementation is in the supplied assembly, so the motion semantics are inferred from these two source facts.

functions.name: Roll or slide the main view
functions.behaviour: Use horizontal right-drag to roll and vertical right-drag for a 4D slide through the retained MPUlt camera.
entry_points: key Main viewport: Right mouse drag
functions.notes: The gesture-to-camera mapping is declared in the host's help, and its input gate forwards drags to MPUlt. The actual camera implementation is in the supplied assembly, so the motion semantics are inferred from these two source facts.

functions.name: Adjust the camera radius by dragging
functions.behaviour: Adjust the main camera radius through the retained MPUlt drag handler.
entry_points: key Main viewport: Ctrl+Left mouse drag
functions.notes: The gesture-to-camera mapping is declared in the host's help, and its input gate forwards drags to MPUlt. The actual camera implementation is in the supplied assembly, so the motion semantics are inferred from these two source facts.

functions.name: Adjust field of view by dragging
functions.behaviour: Adjust the main camera field of view through the retained MPUlt drag handler.
entry_points: key Main viewport: Ctrl+Right mouse drag
functions.notes: The gesture-to-camera mapping is declared in the host's help, and its input gate forwards drags to MPUlt. The actual camera implementation is in the supplied assembly, so the motion semantics are inferred from these two source facts.

functions.name: Open the structure explorer
functions.behaviour: Open the Structure tools tab for local cell/color, exact-layer and vertex navigation and generated whole-piece filters.
functions.notes: The Colors, Layers and Vertices task tabs share a selected layer origin. Metadata is fetched during bridge connection.

functions.name: Navigate the structure's color or cell origin
functions.behaviour: Find C1..C600, choose a shared-face neighbor or activate a graph/listed color to make it the local layer origin. Update graph, comparison, layer list and generated expression without automatically centering or applying a filter.
entry_points: key Structure / Find color editor: Enter
key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Left click node
key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Enter
key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Space
key Structure / Layers / Listed colors: Double-click color
button Structure / Layers: Go to listed color
key Structure / Vertices / Incident colors: Double-click color
button Structure / Vertices: Go to incident color
functions.notes: The four neighbor labels change with the selected color. tests/native/NativeStructureExplorerRegression.cs exercises local graph activation, reused neighbor controls and task navigation without a viewport-center event.

functions.name: Choose a graph node with the keyboard
functions.behaviour: Move graph keyboard focus backward or forward through the displayed node order with wraparound; selection waits for Enter or Space.
entry_points: key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Left
key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Up
key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Right
key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Down

functions.name: Read a graph-node tooltip
functions.behaviour: Hover a schematic adjacency node to show its canonical color and selection guidance and a hand cursor; leaving the graph clears both.
entry_points: key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Hover node
key Structure / Color adjacency graph: Mouse leave

functions.name: View a one- or two-hop color graph
functions.behaviour: Display a schematic shared-face adjacency graph around the local color origin, with canonical colors and selected/comparison markers, and choose one or two hops.
entry_points: window Structure / Colors / Graph radius selector (1 hop, 2 hops)

functions.name: Compare two canonical colors
functions.behaviour: Enter a second canonical color and show its shortest shared-face distance from the layer origin and whether the two cells share a triangular face; mark the comparison color on the local graph.
entry_points: key Structure / Compare color editor: Enter

functions.name: Inspect an exact cell-centered layer
functions.behaviour: Choose a graph layer to see its cell count and canonical color list at exactly that shared-face distance from the local origin, and update layer-dependent filter expressions.
entry_points: window Structure / Layers / Cell graph layer selector
window Structure / Layers / Colors in the exact cell layer
functions.notes: Cell shells are disjoint; the displayed source explicitly distinguishes them from overlapping whole-piece selections.

functions.name: Inspect vertex incidence
functions.behaviour: Choose one of the selected cell's four V-labelled vertex buttons or enter V1..V120 to list its twenty incident colors. Vertex selection retains the current cell-layer origin.
entry_points: window Structure / Vertices / Vertex number selector (V1..V120)
window Structure / Vertices / Twenty incident colors

functions.name: Prepare a structural filter predicate
functions.behaviour: Choose color identities, current cell positions, adjacent positions, current cell layer or home identities in a layer to generate the matching expression from the local origin and selected layer. Changing the predicate invalidates prior preview counts.
entry_points: button Structure / Layers: Use current layer
button Structure / Layers: Use home layer
window Structure / Filter options / Structure predicate selector

functions.name: Choose filter composition
functions.behaviour: Choose Replace current filter, Intersect current filter or Union with current filter; invalidate earlier counts so the selected composition needs a new preview.
entry_points: window Structure / Filter options / Filter composition selector

functions.name: Preview a composed structural filter
functions.behaviour: Request whole-piece and sticker counts for the generated predicate composed with existing rules. Show added/removed piece counts and the complete composed rules only for a current request with unchanged state and filter.
functions.notes: tests/native/NativeStructureExplorerRegression.cs exercises the control's count-before-apply and stale response behavior; tests/native/NativeHostRegression.cs covers response ordering in CompleteExplorerPreview. These are read test fixtures, not executed native results.

functions.name: Apply the reviewed structural filter
functions.behaviour: Apply the reviewed composed rules with the returned context hash only while the preview's request, puzzle state and original filter still match; otherwise require another preview.

functions.name: Insert a structural expression into the filter editor
functions.behaviour: Copy the generated structural expression into Filters and focus its editor for editing without applying it.

functions.name: Show structural filter options
functions.behaviour: Show or hide the predicate and composition selectors under the persistent filter actions.

functions.name: Review complete composed filter rules
functions.behaviour: Show or hide the scrollable preview detail containing whole-piece/sticker counts and complete composed rules.

functions.name: Center the main viewport from Structure
functions.behaviour: Set the toolbar cell to the structure's selected canonical color, recenter the main viewport, reload grips and send the corresponding focus context.

functions.name: Open the global cell overview
functions.behaviour: Open or reactivate the modeless global window, or its compact drawer view, showing all 600 canonical cells in a true 4D geometry projection. Display active-orbit/eligible solved counts, exact visible/unsolved counts and buffer/selected-piece markers.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Global cell overview
menu Main toolbar: Cell views > Global overview · 600 cells
button Views / Global overview: Open global
key Global overview — C600 Studio: drag title bar
key Global overview — C600 Studio: resize window
functions.engine_call: POST /api/focus (only if no focus is set)
functions.notes: The native host queues initial focus when it opens an auxiliary with no server focus; view geometry and status are already cached.

functions.name: Open the focused cell neighborhood
functions.behaviour: Open or reactivate the modeless neighborhood window, or its compact drawer view, showing tetrahedral cells within the selected shared-face radius of its origin. Display canonical cell status and separate origin, selection and hover highlights.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Focused cell neighborhood
menu Main toolbar: Cell views > Focused neighborhood
button Views / Focused neighborhood: Open local
key Focused neighborhood — C600 Studio: drag title bar
key Focused neighborhood — C600 Studio: resize window
functions.engine_call: POST /api/focus (only if no focus is set)

functions.name: Close an auxiliary view
functions.behaviour: Hide the global or local auxiliary view and stop its rendering while preserving its independent camera, selection and pinned local origin for reopening.
entry_points: key Global overview — C600 Studio: title-bar Close
key Focused neighborhood — C600 Studio: title-bar Close

functions.name: Reset auxiliary window positions
functions.behaviour: Place the two auxiliary windows at their default nonoverlapping locations in the current working area, leaving their cameras and local origin intact.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: View > Reset auxiliary window positions
menu Main toolbar: Cell views > Reset window positions

functions.name: Rotate an auxiliary camera
functions.behaviour: Rotate either auxiliary projection independently with an arcball drag or unmodified arrow keys; a drag beyond the movement threshold does not select a cell.
entry_points: key Global overview canvas: Left mouse drag
key Focused neighborhood canvas: Left mouse drag
functions.notes: tests/native/NativeCellViewRegression.cs exercises arrow rotation and arcball drag while checking independence from the other auxiliary camera; no native fixture was run.

functions.name: Zoom an auxiliary camera
functions.behaviour: Zoom either auxiliary view independently with the wheel or unmodified add/plus and subtract/minus keys, clamped to 0.4..4.
entry_points: key Global overview canvas: Mouse wheel
key Global overview canvas: NumPad Add
key Global overview canvas: Oemplus (=, unmodified)
key Global overview canvas: NumPad Subtract
key Global overview canvas: OemMinus (-, unmodified)

key Focused neighborhood canvas: NumPad Add

functions.name: Reset an auxiliary camera
functions.behaviour: Restore the selected auxiliary's initial orientation and unit zoom without changing the other camera or main viewport.
entry_points: menu Global overview canvas: Reset this camera
menu Focused neighborhood canvas: Reset this camera

functions.name: Inspect auxiliary cell hover and status
functions.behaviour: Hover a projected cell to show its canonical ID, buffer/selected-piece context and physical-position counts, and synchronize hover highlighting in the other auxiliary. Leaving the view clears its hover when it is not being dragged.
entry_points: key Global overview canvas: Hover cell
key Global overview canvas: Mouse leave
key Focused neighborhood canvas: Hover cell
key Focused neighborhood canvas: Mouse leave
functions.notes: Hover emits no selection or engine request; the count tooltip warns that physical-position cell counts can overlap.

functions.name: Center the main camera from an auxiliary
functions.behaviour: Explicitly center the main viewport on the selected canonical cell, reload its grips and queue focus. In the compact drawer the canvas's Enter key requests the same action.
entry_points: menu Global overview canvas: Center main on selected C
menu Focused neighborhood canvas: Center main on selected C
key Main workbench / Views / Global overview canvas: Enter
key Main workbench / Views / Focused neighborhood canvas: Enter

functions.name: Follow selection or pin the neighborhood origin
functions.behaviour: Choose Follow selection to move the neighborhood origin as another canonical cell is selected, or Pin this origin to retain the current origin while selection continues to change.
entry_points: window Focused neighborhood / Neighborhood origin mode selector (Follow selection, Pin this origin)

functions.name: Choose the neighborhood radius
functions.behaviour: Choose 1 hop or 2 hops to rebuild the local auxiliary's visible cells using exact shared-face adjacency from its retained origin.
entry_points: window Focused neighborhood / Neighborhood radius selector (1 hop, 2 hops)

functions.name: Use the compact auxiliary drawer
functions.behaviour: Use the Views drawer when the main window or working area is too small for separate auxiliary windows, and return to modeless windows when space permits. View cameras and pinned origin survive reparenting, and only visible active views render.

functions.behaviour: Use Enter or Space on a focused drawer button, and arrows/Home/End to change a focused drawer selector. F4 or Space toggles its dropdown, Enter or Escape closes it, and Tab retains normal focus navigation.

functions.name: Inspect runtime assembly metadata
functions.behaviour: Read a supplied PE/CLI assembly without loading it, report its SHA-256 and missing required reflection names as JSON, and optionally write the report. Exit status indicates whether required names are missing.
functions.notes: The report's declared scope is metadata-name inspection, not compilation, geometry validation or a Windows/DirectX test.

functions.name: Collect bounded native diagnostics
functions.behaviour: Collect redacted tails of enumerated startup/build/debug files and safe launch metadata into a ZIP, plus matching legacy test report/log files, and print its path and file count.
functions.notes: As written, the collector scans native-host-0.2.3, native-host-0.2.2 and native-host-0.2.1, and tests/v022 and tests/v021; it does not scan the bootstrap's 0.3 build directory. Its contents note calls for review before sharing.

functions.name: Patch a pinned upstream renderer checkout
functions.behaviour: Apply the fixed ray-bound and visibility/projection edits to an explicitly supplied ivan216/MPUlt MeshObj.cs only when its Git blob matches the inspected source. Preserve a .cs.pre-c600 backup and refuse differing source, ambiguous anchors or an existing backup.
functions.notes: This is an explicit developer CLI, not a normal startup action; it changes the supplied checkout and does not fetch or build it.

functions.name: Run explicit WinForms fixture checks
functions.behaviour: Compile the host and NativeHostRegression fixture, run the isolated startup/layout fixture, save build logs and its JSON/log report, and stop before loading MPUlt or opening the puzzle engine.
functions.notes: Windows and 64-bit Python are required; this inventories the mode from source and does not claim that it ran.

functions.name: Run explicit native renderer regressions
functions.behaviour: With an explicit fresh data directory, run the WinForms fixture prerequisite, compile the actual MPUlt/DirectX renderer regression with its related checks and verified reference bindings, then run it against an owned engine.
functions.notes: The native test is a separate explicit mode and refuses an existing session.sqlite3. Neither it nor its WinForms prerequisite was run in this Linux inventory task.

functions.name: Run explicit native performance checks
functions.behaviour: With an explicit fresh data directory, run the WinForms prerequisite, compile the native performance regression with verified DirectX bindings and launch it against an owned engine with a 30-minute timeout.
functions.notes: The performance mode is inventoried from source only; no timing, native input or Windows/DirectX result is asserted.

functions.name: Read native CLI usage
functions.behaviour: Print argparse-generated usage and argument help for the bootstrap, assembly inspector, diagnostics collector or source patcher, then exit before their work executes.

functions.name: Read native startup and operation errors
functions.behaviour: Display argument guidance, failed bridge/startup or UI-completion errors, and fatal unrecoverable UI exceptions in modal messages. Record native diagnostics and, on startup failure, a native_start_error.txt file when possible.
functions.notes: Device-loss exceptions take the internal retry path instead of the fatal UI error dialog. The source's generic MessageBox dismissal is used.

functions.name: Undo a text edit in an editor
functions.behaviour: Use Ctrl+Z while an editor owns focus to undo text when the focused TextBox can undo, without invoking puzzle undo.
functions.notes: The editor branch checks the Control modifier and Z key code without excluding Shift, so Ctrl+Shift+Z takes the same text-undo path.

functions.name: Navigate the native menu groups
functions.behaviour: Open the File, Edit, View, Puzzle, Help or Cell views menu groups; F10 retains the normal WinForms menu-access behavior.

functions.name: Scramble with 1,000 turns
functions.behaviour: Request and immediately apply a 1,000-turn scramble through the labelled backend, then refresh the native committed state.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: Puzzle > Scramble 1,000 turns (undoable)

functions.name: Edit and save native keybindings
functions.behaviour: Edit the native Windows-key-to-action JSON mapping, validate action names, grip indices and duplicate combinations, then save native_keys.json and close the editor. Invalid input opens an Invalid bindings dialog.
functions.notes: The full accepted action catalog is represented by the NativeWorkbench.KeyAction entries elsewhere in this inventory. Startup loads the saved mapping, preserving an invalid file while keeping defaults.

functions.name: Undo a puzzle operation
functions.behaviour: Undo through the engine journal and refresh the native committed state.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: Edit > Undo  Ctrl+Z

functions.name: Redo a puzzle operation
functions.behaviour: Redo through the engine journal and refresh the native committed state.
entry_points: menu Main workbench: Edit > Redo  Ctrl+Shift+Z

functions.name: Read live native status
functions.behaviour: Read connection or working messages, the solved moving-piece count, primitive turns and journal head, and the exact visible/interactive totals and edited-filter indicator.

internal_only.name: menu Main workbench: View > Instant turns after durable commit
internal_only.reason: Disabled checked status item with no event handler; no animation-mode command is offered.

internal_only.name: Hidden inherited UI: panel1, splitter1, menuStrip1, panel3, splitter2 and original display TrackBars
internal_only.reason: The old designer controls are hidden. Display TrackBars are driven through the separately inventoried native dialog copies; hidden legacy controls have no independent entry here.

internal_only.name: Menu and toolbar separators
internal_only.reason: Visual grouping only, with no command or event handler.

internal_only.name: key Main workbench: Alt+left/right mouse button down/up
internal_only.reason: The message filter consumes these events; they do not dispatch a host action.

internal_only.name: Unassigned inherited function-key and accelerator guards
internal_only.reason: F1..F12 are consumed when not handled by a current binding or menu-access exception; editor F-keys are also consumed. Unmapped Ctrl chords and Alt+M are blocked rather than invoking original history/setup/macros.

internal_only.name: Editor standard-key pass-through: Ctrl+A/C/V/X/Left/Right/Home/End/Back/Delete/Insert/ControlKey
internal_only.reason: These keys are only permitted to reach normal WinForms editing; this shard defines no separate command for their built-in behavior. Ctrl+Z handling is inventoried as text undo.

internal_only.name: Structure standard-control pass-through: Enter, Space, Left, Right, Up, Down, Home, End, PageUp and PageDown outside the graph handlers
internal_only.reason: The host allows ordinary control navigation rather than dispatching native workbench actions. The graph's actual arrow and activation handlers and the two search Enter handlers are inventoried separately.

internal_only.name: Auxiliary drawer shortcut isolation and ignored canvas Escape
internal_only.reason: After owned navigation/centering, the compact observation area consumes unrelated inherited shortcuts. Escape on its canvas has no command effect; drawer buttons and selectors have separate inventoried handlers.

internal_only.name: Native input auto-repeat suppression
internal_only.reason: A held mapped key is consumed after its initial transition without repeating KeyAction.

internal_only.name: Reflection helpers and authenticated HTTP client/job polling
internal_only.reason: Internal member access, JSON and HTTP transport. Endpoint strings are clients of other shards' routes; this shard registers no HTTP routes.

internal_only.name: Full-geometry bridge export and authoritative native snapshot publication
internal_only.reason: Connection and command support for complete geometry, state/colors, visibility, inspection and scratch-state synchronization; no separate user command.

internal_only.name: NativeSnapshot parsing and delta materialization
internal_only.reason: Internal protocol/profile/revision and array validation and full/delta conversion, used by native display refresh.

internal_only.name: NativeStickerAccess compiled member access and style coloring
internal_only.reason: Internal mesh dimensions, palette handling and annotation styles; no menu, key binding or route.

internal_only.name: NativeFullRenderer verified upload-buffer adapter
internal_only.reason: Automatically installs a renderer proxy and reusable upload path when the supplied binary and IL match. Enabled/counters are internal diagnostic properties, not exposed controls.

internal_only.name: NativeRenderSubset full/visible/motion draw scopes and framework meshes
internal_only.reason: Renderer-only array/field scopes, focus outlines and sampling support inventoried view policies; no independent mechanical operation or user command.

internal_only.name: NativeRendererLifecycle scheduling, explicit frame probes and device recovery
internal_only.reason: Timer-based rendering, resize/reset and device-loss retry are automatic. RenderFrame, PreparePicking, Pause/Resume, frame timing and counters are internal/test interfaces, not user diagnostics commands.

internal_only.name: NativePickingVisibility hit tests, click guards and inspection handoff
internal_only.reason: Internal visibility/interaction masks, ray occlusion and native message bookkeeping support the separately listed click and drag functions; hit/click counters are not a visible tool.

internal_only.name: Native cell geometry/status validation and projection helpers
internal_only.reason: Parse immutable geometry and count metadata and derive local render/pick coordinates. These helpers introduce no extra engine or UI entry.

internal_only.name: Structure explorer topology and schematic graph algorithms
internal_only.reason: Copied adjacency/incidence, BFS distances, predicate generation and graph layout support local navigation and filter controls; no standalone route or CLI.

internal_only.name: Asynchronous request completion and structural preview freshness guards
internal_only.reason: Internal request ordering, busy gating, state/rule checks and error publication; visible Preview/Apply actions are inventoried separately.

internal_only.name: Native camera capture, saved-camera restore and dimension synchronization
internal_only.reason: Shared support for checkpoint/reset/import and initial connection. Recenter, Reset view and visible sliders have their own rows.

internal_only.name: Session timer heartbeat
internal_only.reason: Automatic five-second POST /api/timer with action=heartbeat while connected and idle; there is no user-facing heartbeat control.

internal_only.name: NativeDiagnostics.DirectoryPath and Write
internal_only.reason: Automatic timestamped debug logging with a 4-MiB rotation threshold and a fallback location. Collection and error dialogs are separately inventoried user entries.

internal_only.name: bootstrap compiler recipes, reference bindings and runtime-cache preparation
internal_only.reason: Build/reference validation, configuration copy and local cache/preferences carry-forward support the listed CLI modes; no separate CLI option exposes these helpers.

internal_only.name: directx_runtime.verified and find_directx
internal_only.reason: Imported dependency discovery and checksum verification in bounded existing locations, with missing-runtime guidance. The module has no __main__ or independent CLI and installs nothing.

internal_only.name: inspect_runtime.REQUIRED and inspect metadata parser
internal_only.reason: Internal PE/CLI metadata parser also reused by bootstrap; the inspector's CLI/report are inventoried separately.

internal_only.name: collect_diagnostics.text_tail and safe-launch filtering
internal_only.reason: Bounded reads, redact and a pid/protocol/model_id allowlist support the diagnostics ZIP rather than exposing an independent action.

internal_only.name: patch_ivan_renderer.git_blob and fixed patch anchors
internal_only.reason: Content and anchor checks supporting the explicit source-patch CLI, not an additional entry.

unclear.name: Complete inherited MPUlt input semantics
unclear.reason: This shard describes and forwards native camera drags and gates/captures native clicks, but the supplied MPUlt assembly owns the full grip gesture catalog and wheel/navigation-key camera mappings. The inventory records the callbacks and declared drag meanings; exact additional inherited variants cannot be established from this shard's source.
